comment: Tests allowed to build an external app reply inline. "deliberate" needs a reason no real app reply would do; "pending" is a to-do that scripts/check-recorded-replies.mjs makes you delete (#1237). "noBehaviour" lists a recording no test replays because Deluno has no behaviour for the call it shows; scripts/check-recorded-replies.mjs fails for any other recording that no test names.

The Plex collection calls (list, create, describe, children, delete) are recorded from an unclaimed Plex 1.43.4 and replayed in PlexOnRecordingsTests. FakePlex here still builds Plex's collection replies inline because it also answers the home-screen promotion (/hubs/sections/{id}/manage), which the unclaimed server answers 404; a claimed server's reply is not recorded (tests/fixtures/recorded/MISSING.md, 'Plex, claimed'). The Jellyfin and Emby tests in this file are not Plex and carry no flagged reply.

Emby 4.10.1.0, Jellyfin 12.2.0 and an unclaimed Plex 1.43.4 are recorded (tests/fixtures/recorded/emby, jellyfin, plex), and the same operations are replayed from them in EmbyOnRecordingsTests, PlexOnRecordingsTests, RecordedJellyfinTests and JellyfinOperationsOnRecordingsTests. This file's tests still build their replies inline for what the recordings do not hold: Plex's 'is the account everyone' tests, ratings, favourites and watchlist, which need plex.tv's user, friend, shared-server and home lists and a token that names an owner (only plex.tv's own 401 with no token is recorded: it needs a claimed server, tests/fixtures/recorded/MISSING.md), and the synthetic Jellyfin and Emby cases that need several users, a second page of 500 films or a grouped listing. Move each onto a recording by changing one value of the Emby or Jellyfin catalogue reply as they are taken up.

The guard finds one key it takes for a Seerr reply (#1237): the pasted Radarr export carries a movie file with "mediaInfo" (video and audio codec) and custom formats. That is a Radarr movie-file reply, not Seerr's. The recorded Radarr 6.4.4 (tests/fixtures/recorded/radarr) holds a film but no file, so no recorded reply has a movieFile. To move this test onto a recording, record Radarr holding the film file (put a film in its root folder, rescan, then GET /api/v3/movie): see tests/fixtures/recorded/MISSING.md.

Property tests (#1271): the feed is written by Deluno's own TorznabFeed.Write from generated releases and read back, to prove the reader never throws on any text and round-trips title, size and date. Generated input is the point; no recorded reply can stand in for arbitrary text. Real Torznab replies are tested from tests/fixtures/recorded/jackett.

The uTorrent part builds its reply inline because uTorrent is not recorded (it needs the Windows CI runner; #1272). Every other client in the file, rTorrent included, replays its recorded reply with one path swapped. Delete this entry once uTorrent is recorded and this part loads it.

noBehaviour.reason: SABnzbd's mode=change_cat on a queued job. Deluno sets a Usenet job's category only when it adds it; it never moves an existing Usenet job to another category (keep-seeding moves are for torrents).
SABnzbd's mode=change_cat to a category it does not have. Deluno never moves an existing Usenet job to another category.
NZBGet's editqueue GroupSetCategory on a queued job. Deluno never moves an existing Usenet job to another category.

SABnzbd's mode=addfile with a file that is not an NZB, an empty file and an XML file that is not an NZB: each answers {"status": false}. Deluno adds a Usenet release by its link (mode=addurl) and never uploads an NZB file, so it has no behaviour for these three calls (Sonarr and Radarr upload the file; the link is what the add-url states show). Kept as the real answer if a file add is ever built.

SABnzbd's mode=addlocalfile for a path it does not hold: {"status": false, "error": "file does not exist"}. Deluno never asks SABnzbd to read a file from its disk, so it has no behaviour for the call.
